# KI-136 — Helper lifecycle

**Lane:** helper · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KI-110 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [plan](../../../plans/2026-10-02-001-feat-internal-mode-plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts.md) · [roster and graph](../roster.md) · researched at `5ad41c8b`
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `packages/agent/src/local/lifecycle.ts`, `packages/agent/src/local/lifecycle.test.ts`

## Outcome

`packages/agent/src/local/lifecycle.ts` lets any Khala process (the `khala local` CLI, an agent's `LocalSession`) get a running helper without the user ever starting one:

- `helperPaths(env)` names the helper's files, port and origin;
- `readHelperFile(env)` reads and validates `<stateRoot>/local/helper.json`;
- `ensureHelper(env, deps)` returns `{ origin, adminToken }` of a healthy helper, starting one detached in the background (`process.execPath <repo>/packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs local serve`, output appended to `helper.log`) when none answers, and fails with `KhalaClientError('internal_error', 'helper_unavailable')` when none is healthy after 5 s.

Concurrent callers in one process share one attempt (one spawn). Operator-visible: AE1 ("The helper was started if absent") and AE8 ("the next agent call or page action restarts it"). All tests inject `fetch`, `spawn`, `sleep`, `now` and the file opener; no real process is started.

## Context and evidence

- **D2:** "started automatically by the khala CLI/agent when a local channel is created/used, never installed as a service, exits when idle".
- KTD8: "tokens never in argv/env/logs, 0700/0600 via `ensureStateDir`/`writeJsonAtomic`" (`/proc/<pid>/cmdline` and `/proc/<pid>/environ` of a same-uid process are readable; cmdline is world-readable).
- research-2 §8 "Daemon lifecycle": detached child, `unref()`, logs to a file in `local/`; §5 "Single-instance daemon: bind the port first (EADDRINUSE → probe `/healthz`; if the instance is healthy, reuse it)".
- Consumers of the pinned names: **KI-137** (`khala local …` commands call `ensureHelper`, `readHelperFile`, `helperPaths`), **KI-121** (`createLocalSession` calls `ensureHelper` on connection refused, per the plan's integration ledger), **KI-151/KI-160** (run the helper under the egress guard, which travels through `NODE_OPTIONS`).

## Scope

`helperPaths`, `readHelperFile`, `ensureHelper`, `helperBinPath`, `HELPER_ENV_ALLOWLIST`, `helperChildEnv`, and `lifecycle.test.ts`.

## Non-goals

- The helper process itself (`khala local serve`: bind, `EADDRINUSE` → exit 0, writing/removing `helper.json`, idle exit): **KI-137**.
- The HTTP server: **KI-131**. The store: **KI-130**.
- Stopping a helper (`khala local stop`): **KI-137**.
- Retrying requests after the helper is up, backoff, respawn policy inside a long-poll loop: **KI-121**.
- Any user-facing printing: callers decide.

## Contract and invariants

Contracts L11, verbatim:

```ts
export type HelperFile = { v: 1; pid: number; port: number; origin: string; adminToken: string; version: string; startedAt: string };
```

> - Binds `127.0.0.1` only, port `KHALA_LOCAL_PORT` or `LOCAL_DEFAULT_PORT` (47830). `EADDRINUSE`: if `GET /healthz` on that port answers `{ok:true}` the new process exits 0 (another helper owns it); otherwise it fails with `port_in_use` (no silent port move: links embed the port).
> - `ensureHelper(env)` (KI-136): read `helper.json`; `GET /healthz` with a 500 ms timeout; on success return `{ origin, adminToken }`; otherwise spawn `process.execPath <repo>/packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs local serve` detached (`stdio` to `helper.log`, `unref()`), then poll `/healthz` every 100 ms for up to 5 s; failure → `KhalaClientError('internal_error','helper_unavailable')`. Tokens never appear in argv or env (`/proc/*/cmdline` is world-readable).

Contracts L2, verbatim (the two files this ticket reads or creates):

> ```text
>   local/                              0700
>     helper.json                       0600  L11 HelperFile; written only by the running helper
>     helper.log                        0600  helper stderr/stdout (no message bodies, no tokens)
> ```

Contracts L6, verbatim: `// GET    /healthz                                             → { ok: true, version: string, pid: number }   (no auth, no data)`

Existing error type, verbatim (`packages/agent/src/client.ts:14-22`):

```ts
export type KhalaErrorCode = 'invalid_link' | 'link_unavailable' | 'join_expired' | 'not_connected' | 'send_failed' | 'session_unknown' | 'internal_error';
export class KhalaClientError extends Error {
  readonly code: KhalaErrorCode;
  constructor(code: KhalaErrorCode, message?: string) { … }
}
```

### This ticket's pinned API (KI-137 and KI-121 quote it verbatim)

```ts
// packages/agent/src/local/lifecycle.ts
export type HelperPaths = { root: string; helperFile: string; logFile: string; port: number; origin: string };
export function helperPaths(env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): HelperPaths;
//   root = <stateRoot(env)>/local; helperFile = <root>/helper.json; logFile = <root>/helper.log;
//   port = KHALA_LOCAL_PORT when it is a decimal integer 1..65535, else LOCAL_DEFAULT_PORT; origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`
export function readHelperFile(env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Promise<HelperFile | null>;   // null when missing or not a valid HelperFile
export function helperBinPath(): string;                                                 // absolute path of packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs
export const HELPER_ENV_ALLOWLIST: readonly string[];
export function helperChildEnv(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
export type EnsureHelperDeps = {
  fetch?: typeof fetch;
  spawn?: (command: string, argv: readonly string[], options: SpawnOptions) => { unref(): void; on(event: 'error', listener: (error: Error) => void): unknown };
  sleep?: (ms: number) => Promise<void>;
  now?: () => number;
  openLog?: (file: string) => Promise<number>;   // returns a file descriptor opened for append, mode 0600
};
export function ensureHelper(env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv, deps?: EnsureHelperDeps): Promise<{ origin: string; adminToken: string }>;
// throws KhalaClientError('internal_error', 'helper_unavailable'); StateError('unsafe_state_dir') passes through unchanged
```

### Invariants

1. **Directories.** Before opening `helper.log`, call `ensureStateDir(path.join(root, 'channels'))`. **Never `ensureStateDir(root)`**: it checks two parent levels (`packages/agent/src/state.ts:40`), which for `<stateRoot>/local` is `$XDG_STATE_HOME`/`~/.local/state`, commonly `0755` on real machines → `unsafe_state_dir` in production. `<root>/channels` checks `<stateRoot>`, `<root>`, `channels` — the Khala-owned levels. (KI-130 and KI-137 follow the same rule.)
2. **Healthy** means: `fetch(<origin>/healthz, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(500) })` resolves `200` with a JSON body where `ok === true`. Anything else (throw, timeout, other status, bad JSON) is unhealthy. When checking an existing `helper.json`, it must also hold that `body.pid === file.pid` (a different process on the port is not our helper).
3. **Fast path.** `readHelperFile(env)` returns a file and its origin is healthy → return `{ origin: file.origin, adminToken: file.adminToken }` with **no spawn**.
4. **Slow path.** Otherwise (no file, invalid file, unhealthy):
   1. `ensureStateDir(<root>/channels)`;
   2. `fd = await openLog(logFile)` — default opener: `fs.open(logFile, 'a', 0o600)`, then `handle.chmod(0o600)` (an older log may have wider bits), return `handle.fd` and keep the handle to close after spawning;
   3. `child = spawn(process.execPath, [helperBinPath(), 'local', 'serve'], { detached: true, stdio: ['ignore', fd, fd], env: helperChildEnv(env), cwd: root, shell: false })`; register `child.on('error', …)` (record it; it makes the attempt fail fast); `child.unref()`; close the parent's copy of the fd;
   4. poll every 100 ms (`sleep(100)`), until `now()` passes the start + 5000 ms: `readHelperFile(env)` returns a file **and** its origin is healthy with a matching `pid` → return `{ origin, adminToken }`. Healthz alone is not enough: the helper writes `helper.json` right after it binds (KI-137), and the admin token is only in that file.
   5. Deadline passed or a spawn `error` was recorded → throw `KhalaClientError('internal_error', 'helper_unavailable')`.
5. **No secrets in argv or env.** argv is exactly `[helperBinPath(), 'local', 'serve']`. The child env is `helperChildEnv(env)`: only the keys in `HELPER_ENV_ALLOWLIST` that are defined in `env`:
   `['PATH', 'HOME', 'USER', 'LOGNAME', 'LANG', 'LC_ALL', 'TMPDIR', 'XDG_STATE_HOME', 'NODE_OPTIONS', 'KHALA_LOCAL_PORT', 'KHALA_LOCAL_IDLE_MS', 'KHALA_LOCAL_WEB_DIR']`.
   (`USER`/`HOME`/`XDG_STATE_HOME` feed `resolveLocalOwnerName` and `stateRoot` in the child; `NODE_OPTIONS` carries the KI-151 egress-guard `--import` preload; nothing on the list carries a token. The CLI's or agent's other env — API keys, `KHALA_*` session vars, `CODEX_*`, `CLAUDE_*` — is not inherited.)
6. **One attempt per process per helper file.** A module-level `Map<string, Promise<…>>` keyed by `helperFile` path memoizes the in-flight promise; concurrent `ensureHelper` calls with the same state root await the same promise (one spawn); the entry is deleted in `finally`, so a later call after success re-checks health and after failure retries. Across processes, two spawns can happen; the second helper exits 0 on `EADDRINUSE` + healthy (KI-137), and both callers then read the same `helper.json`.
7. `readHelperFile` = `readJson` + KI-110's `decodeHelperFile` (`packages/contracts/src/m1/local.ts`), then additionally: `pid`, `port` positive safe integers, `port <= 65535`; `origin === 'http://127.0.0.1:' + port`; `adminToken` matches `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/`. Anything else → `null`. A `StateError` from `readJson` (I/O error other than ENOENT) propagates.
8. Nothing is logged by this module. Error messages never contain the admin token.

### Worked example

`env = { HOME: '/home/kevin', USER: 'kevin', PATH: '/usr/bin', OPENAI_API_KEY: 'sk-x', NODE_OPTIONS: '--import /x/guard.mjs' }`, no helper running, no `helper.json`.

```text
helperPaths(env) → { root:'/home/kevin/.local/state/khala/local', helperFile:'…/local/helper.json', logFile:'…/local/helper.log', port:47830, origin:'http://127.0.0.1:47830' }
ensureHelper(env):
  readHelperFile → null
  ensureStateDir('/home/kevin/.local/state/khala/local/channels')
  openLog('…/local/helper.log') → fd 23
  spawn('/usr/bin/node', ['/repo/packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs', 'local', 'serve'],
        { detached:true, stdio:['ignore',23,23], cwd:'…/khala/local', shell:false,
          env:{ HOME:'/home/kevin', USER:'kevin', PATH:'/usr/bin', NODE_OPTIONS:'--import /x/guard.mjs' } })   // no OPENAI_API_KEY
  child.unref()
  t=0    readHelperFile → null                                                     sleep(100)
  t=100  readHelperFile → null                                                     sleep(100)
  t=200  readHelperFile → { v:1, pid:4242, port:47830, origin:'http://127.0.0.1:47830', adminToken:'Q…43', version:'0.0.0', startedAt:'2026-10-02T12:00:00.000Z' }
         GET http://127.0.0.1:47830/healthz → 200 {"ok":true,"version":"0.0.0","pid":4242}
  → { origin:'http://127.0.0.1:47830', adminToken:'Q…43' }
```

### Steps

1. Imports: `node:fs/promises`, `node:path`, `node:url` (`fileURLToPath`), `node:child_process` (`spawn` as `nodeSpawn`, `type SpawnOptions`); `stateRoot`, `ensureStateDir`, `readJson` from `../state`; `KhalaClientError` from `../client`; `LOCAL_DEFAULT_PORT`, `decodeHelperFile` and `type HelperFile` from `@khala/contracts/m1/local`.
2. `helperBinPath()`: `fileURLToPath(new URL('../../bin/khala.mjs', import.meta.url))`.
3. `helperPaths(env = process.env)`: parse `KHALA_LOCAL_PORT` with `/^\d{1,5}$/` and range 1..65535.
4. `readHelperFile(env)`: `readJson<unknown>(helperFile)` → validator (invariant 7).
5. `healthy(fetchImpl, origin, pid?)` helper per invariant 2; never throws.
6. `ensureHelper(env = process.env, deps = {})`: resolve deps defaults (`globalThis.fetch`, `nodeSpawn`, `ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms))`, `Date.now`, default `openLog`); memoize per invariant 6; fast path; slow path.
7. Wrap unexpected errors in the slow path (spawn throwing synchronously, `openLog` failing) as `helper_unavailable`, except `StateError` from `ensureStateDir`, which propagates so the CLI can print `unsafe_state_dir`.

## Test scenarios

File: `packages/agent/src/local/lifecycle.test.ts`. `env = { XDG_STATE_HOME: tmp, … }` with `tmp` from `fs.mkdtemp`. Fakes: `fetch` answering from a function of URL; `spawn` recording `(command, argv, options)` and returning `{ unref: vi.fn(), on: vi.fn() }`; `sleep` advancing a fake clock by `ms` (and optionally writing `helper.json` at a chosen tick to simulate the child); `openLog` returning a fake fd (or the real default against `tmp`).

1. **Paths.** `helperPaths({ XDG_STATE_HOME: '/s' })` → root `/s/khala/local`, port 47830, origin `http://127.0.0.1:47830`; `KHALA_LOCAL_PORT: '5000'` → 5000; `'0'`, `'70000'`, `'12a'` → 47830.
2. **Bin path.** `helperBinPath()` ends with `packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs` and `fs.existsSync` is true.
3. **readHelperFile.** Missing → `null`; valid file (written with `writeJsonAtomic`) → the object; each of: `v: 2`, `origin` with another port, a 10-char `adminToken`, `pid: -1`, unparsable JSON → `null`.
4. **Fast path.** Valid `helper.json` and healthz `{ok:true,pid:<same>}` → returns `{ origin, adminToken }`; `spawn` never called; the healthz request used a 500 ms abort signal (assert `init.signal` is an `AbortSignal`).
5. **Stale file.** `helper.json` exists but healthz throws `ECONNREFUSED` → spawns once with `process.execPath`, argv `[helperBinPath(), 'local', 'serve']`, `detached: true`, `stdio[0] === 'ignore'`, `stdio[1] === stdio[2] === <fd>`, `shell: false`; `unref` called once; then the fake child writes a new `helper.json` (pid 4242) at the 3rd sleep and healthz answers pid 4242 → resolves with the new admin token. Exactly 3 sleeps of 100 ms before success.
6. **Different process on the port.** `helper.json` pid 1 but healthz answers pid 2 → treated as unhealthy → spawn.
7. **Timeout.** Healthz never healthy → rejects `KhalaClientError` with `code: 'internal_error'` and `message: 'helper_unavailable'` after the fake clock passes 5000 ms (≈ 50 sleeps, assert `>= 49 && <= 51`).
8. **Spawn error.** `spawn` returns a child whose `on('error')` listener is invoked immediately → rejects `helper_unavailable` without waiting 5 s (fewer than 3 sleeps).
9. **No secrets.** With `env` containing `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `KHALA_SESSION_TOKEN`, `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID`, `NODE_OPTIONS`, `XDG_STATE_HOME`, `USER`, the spawned `options.env` deep-equals exactly the allowlisted subset; `JSON.stringify(argv)` does not contain the admin token from the eventual `helper.json`; the thrown error in scenario 7 does not contain any token.
10. **Concurrency.** `Promise.all([ensureHelper(env, deps), ensureHelper(env, deps)])` with no helper → `spawn` called exactly once and both resolve to the same value. After it resolves, a third call takes the fast path (no new spawn).
11. **Log file.** With the default `openLog` against `tmp`: `helper.log` exists with mode `0o600`; `<tmp>/khala/local` and `<tmp>/khala/local/channels` are `0o700`. Pre-create `helper.log` with `0o644` → after `ensureHelper` it is `0o600`.
12. **Production layout.** `tmp` chmod `0o755` (simulating `~/.local/state`) → `ensureHelper` still reaches the spawn (no `unsafe_state_dir`).

Mutation checks (each must fail a test, then revert): drop the memoization (scenario 10); return as soon as healthz is ok without reading `helper.json` (scenario 5 — admin token would be missing/stale); pass `env` through unfiltered (scenario 9); call `ensureStateDir(root)` instead of `<root>/channels` (scenario 12).

## Acceptance

- [ ] The pinned exports exist with the exact signatures above.
- [ ] Scenarios 1–12 pass; the four mutation checks were tried and caught.
- [ ] The child argv is exactly `[bin, 'local', 'serve']`, the child env is the allowlist subset, and no test fake ever sees a token outside `helper.json`.
- [ ] No new dependency; imports are Node built-ins, `../state`, `../client`, `@khala/contracts/m1/local`.

## Risks and stop conditions

- KI-110 ships `HelperFile` and `decodeHelperFile` in `packages/contracts/src/m1/local.ts` (its Scope 1 and "Pinned additions"). **Stop** if they are missing there; do not define a second copy here.
- **Stop** if `packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs` moved (KI-137 edits it but must not move it).
- `process.execPath` under vitest is the Node binary; `bin/khala.mjs` registers `tsx` itself (`packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs:3-5`), so no extra loader flag is needed. Do not add `--import tsx` to argv.
- The spawned helper inherits `cwd: root`; never `cwd` inside the repo (a mise/direnv hook there could hang the child).
- `KI-121` calls `ensureHelper` from inside an agent MCP process; keep the module free of top-level side effects so importing it is cheap.

## Complexity rationale

2: a small state machine (fast path, spawn, bounded poll) with dependency injection; the subtleties are the env allowlist, the `ensureStateDir` level rule and single-flight memoization, all unit-testable with fakes.

Standing rule: do not raise human_required decisions for anything this ticket answers; do not add blockers.
